paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.38% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.09%) and Nasdaq weakest (-1.25%). Brent crude changed -1.47% to 102.75. Gold changed +1.26% to 4,209.2998. Bitcoin changed -1.20% to 82,275.0625. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.231%, a relative move of -0.87%. Among the firms tracked, BP (+4.16%) and Occidental (+3.56%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Starbucks has explored takeover of Chipotle in restaurant megadeal (FT World). Purchase of $41bn market-value burrito chain would rank as largest restaurant acquisition of all time Deals and capital markets: A Starbucks-Chipotle merger offers the wrong kind of synergy (FT World). The overlap between the two brands is unlikely to be enough to justify a takeover premium Central banks and macro: Iran war blows near-£12bn hole in Britain’s public finances (FT World). FT estimates show inflation and soaring borrowing costs have slashed chancellor John Healey’s headroom in half Central banks and macro: ECB minutes reflect cooler appetite for additional rate rises in September (FT World). Governing council notes that inflation situation had worsened but that second-round effects remained absent Geopolitics and trade: Oil majors target Middle East despite war disruption (FT Markets). Western groups seek new investment opportunities despite chaos and heightened risks caused by conflict with Iran
